name: Meiche

attributes.attribute: if allowed to grow to maturity, would break forth from his body and devastate the land
warrior of the Tuatha Dé Danann

sources: Gwynn, Edward. The Metrical Dindshenchas. Part II. Vol. IX. Royal Irish Academy, Todd Lecture Series. Dublin: Hodges, Figgis, and Co., Ltd., 1906, 63.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Meiche is an Irish hero. His name is also written Mechi and Merca. He was the son of the war goddess Morrigan. He had three hearts, and in each heart lay a serpent. If the serpents grew they would burst from his body and ravage the land. Mac Cecht, a warrior of the Tuatha De Danann, killed him. The burned body was cast into the River Barrow.
objective: Document Meiche, the hero son of Morrigan.
key_results: the death by Mac Cecht and the Barrow
